title: Exposition on Psalm 20
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Expositions on the Psalms (Augustine) > Psalm 20

paragraphs.text: To the end, a psalm of David.
1. This is a well-known title; and it is not Christ who speaks; but the prophet speaks to Christ, under the form of wishing, foretelling things to come.

2. <quote>The Lord hear You in the day of trouble</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 19:1}} . The Lord hear You in the day in which Thou said, <quote>Father glorify Your Son.</quote> <quote>The name of the God of Jacob protect You.</quote> For to You belongs the younger people. Since <quote>the elder shall serve the younger.</quote>

3. <quote>Send You help from the Holy, and from Sion defend You</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 19:2}} . Making for You a sanctified Body, the Church, from watching safe, which waits when You shall come from the wedding.

4. <quote>Be mindful of all Your sacrifice</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 19:3}} . Make us mindful of all Your injuries and despiteful treatment, which You have borne for us. <quote>And be Your whole burnt offering made fat.</quote> And turn the cross, whereon You were wholly offered up to God, into the joy of the resurrection.

5. Diapsalma. The Lord render to You according to Your Heart {{BIBLE:psa 19:4}} . The Lord render to You, not according to their heart, who thought by persecution they could destroy You; but according to Your Heart, wherein Thou knew what profit Your passion would have. {{BIBLE:joh 12:32}} And fulfil all Your counsel. And fulfil all Your counsel. not only that whereby Thou laid down Your life for Your friends, {{BIBLE:joh 15:13}} that the corrupted grain might rise again to more abundance; {{BIBLE:joh 12:24}} but that also whereby blindness in part has happened unto Israel, that the fullness of the Gentiles might enter in, and so all Israel might be saved. {{BIBLE:rom 11:25}}

6. <quote>We will exult in Your salvation</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 19:5}} . We will exult in that death will in no wise hurt You; for so You will also show that it cannot hurt us either. <quote>And in the name of the Lord our God will we be magnified.</quote> And the confession of Your name shall not only not destroy us, but shall even magnify us.

7. <quote>The Lord fulfil all Your petitions.</quote> The Lord fulfil not only the petitions which You made on earth, but those also whereby Thou intercedest for us in heaven. <quote>Now have I known that the Lord has saved his Christ</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 19:6}} . Now has it been shown to me in prophecy, that the Lord will raise up His Christ again. <quote>He will hear Him from His holy heaven.</quote> He will hear Him not from earth only, where He prayed to be glorified; {{BIBLE:joh 17:1}} but from heaven also, where interceding for us at the Right Hand of the Father, {{BIBLE:heb 7:25}} He has from thence shed abroad the Holy Spirit on them that believe in Him. <quote>In strength is the safety of His right hand.</quote> Our strength is in the safety of His favour, when even out of tribulation He gives help, that <quote>when we are weak, then we may be strong.</quote> {{BIBLE:2co 12:10}} <quote>For vain is</quote> that <quote>safety of man,</quote> which comes not of His right hand but of His left: for thereby are they lifted up to great pride, whosoever in their sins have secured a temporal safety.

8. <quote>Some in chariots, and some in horses</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 19:7}} . Some are drawn away by the ever moving succession of temporal goods; and some are preferred to proud honours, and in them exult: <quote>But we will exult in the name of the Lord our God.</quote> But we, fixing our hope on things eternal, and not seeking our own glory, will exult in the name of the Lord our God.

9. <quote>They have been bound, and fallen</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 19:8}} . And therefore were they bound by the lust of temporal things, fearing to spare the Lord, lest they should lose their place by <quote>the Romans:</quote> {{BIBLE:joh 11:48}} and rushing violently on the stone of offense and rock of stumbling, they fell from the heavenly hope: to whom the blindness in part of Israel has happened, being ignorant of God's righteousness, and wishing to establish their own. <quote>But we are risen, and stand upright.</quote> But we, that the Gentile people might enter in, out of the stones raised up as children to Abraham, {{BIBLE:mat 3:9}} who followed not after righteousness, have attained to it, and are risen; {{BIBLE:rom 9:30}} and not by our own strength, but being justified by faith, we stand upright.

10. <quote>O Lord, save the King:</quote> that He, who in His Passion has shown us an example of conflict, should also offer up our sacrifices, the Priest raised from the dead, and established in heaven. <quote>And hear us in the day when we shall call on You</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 19:9}} . And as He now offers for us, <quote>hear us in the day when we shall call on You.</quote>
